name: Cap Malabata
hero_subtitle: Headland east of Tangier — bay panorama and, on clear days, Spain.

overview.title: Eastern View over the Bay
overview.p1: Cap Malabata sits on the eastern side of the bay, a counterweight to Cap Spartel’s western drama. People come for the view back across Tangier, the lighthouse area, and the sense of the strait opening toward the Mediterranean.
overview.p2: It is a shorter, quieter outing than the Spartel–Hercules loop. Good when you already did the west coast and still want one more horizon.
overview.p3: Clear mornings are best for the Spanish coastline; haze erases it fast.

q1.question: How far from the centre?
q1.answer: A short drive or taxi ride along the bay.

q2.question: Is there a beach?
q2.answer: The point is a viewpoint; use the main municipal beach for swimming.

q3.question: Worth it if I already did Cap Spartel?
q3.answer: Yes if you like viewpoints; skip if you are short on time.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Cap Malabata?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for historical context.

q5.question: Is Cap Malabata suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with normal supervision on steps, cliffs or wet stone.

food.title: Pack or return to town
food.p1: Limited dining on the point — bring water or eat in Tangier.
food.p2: This is a view stop measured in minutes to an hour.
